notes.title: Update August 31, 2022
notes.content:
Hey Labyrinth Players!

This latest update covers a few new items and addresses some bugs as well. Here is the change log:

•	New Reassessment rules and interface.
•	Several updates to the Token Help popup.
•	Added an "end-of-turn" phase for the Jihadist player so that cadres can be removed before passing  play to their opponent.
•	Disrupt overlay now shows the status of selected cells/cadres after resolving.
•	Fixed an issue where information on the Disrupt overlay would disappear when selecting a second target.
•	Fixed some display issues regarding the Tony Blair overlay.
•	Fixed an issue with Radicalization not sending the correct plot event. 
•	Fixed an issue where "Adam Gadahn" was not displaying the Recruit overlay.
•	Fixed an issue where the Posture tokens on the GWOT/Prestige popup could be dragged.
•	Fixed various missing button sounds.
•	Fixed OPs Tray issues for various resolutions.
•	Fixed some Rulebook art and text issues.

Please let us know if you have any issues with the build in the forum and follow these directions for submitting Save Files so we can track them down: https://steamcommunity.com/app/931950/discussions/0/3203745634163788523/

You can send feedback as well as issues to support@playdekgames.com. Thanks for playing!

Playdek

notes.title: Big Changes & Something Really Exciting...
notes.content:
Dear Labyrinth players: today we have a big update that comes with a lot of changes and surprises. 

We are excited to finally bring you the all new US AI mode! This AI has been a work in progress and a long time coming, but we feel like now it is ready to share with you. As we will continue to improve it as time goes on, we would like players to share their save games with cases where the AI makes a poor choice (even if the save game is past that decision point), or if any other problems arise. [u][b]Note:[/b][/u] This AI is currently only implemented for the US, not the Jihadist. 

[u]Patch Notes:[/u]

- Added US A.I. for offline game play

- Besieged Regime token fixed

- US War of Ideas Operation overlay clean up

- Fixed an issue with the UN Nation Building GWOT Penalty and the Total Modifier

- War of Ideas Operations Overlay feedback added

- Clean up to the display of Regime Change and US Prestige Roll

- Fixed game re-load issue not displaying +1 Prestige

- Game log clean up for Travel Attempt and US Prestige Roll

- Jihadist Funding marker display improved for Major Jihad Success result

- Interface display improvements for discard pile reshuffle

- Improved the interface and feedback for selecting posture for a country

- Cleaned up Pause/Unpause

- Art updates and improvements

- Cleaned up Pause/Un-pause

- Updated art and graphics improvements


Thank you guys for your patience and continuous support; we hope you enjoy the new AI and remember, don't forget to let us know if there are any problems or find anything that hinders your playing experience.

tags.bug: - Besieged Regime token fixed
- Fixed an issue with the UN Nation Building GWOT Penalty and the Total Modifier
- Fixed game re-load issue not displaying +1 Prestige

notes.title: Steam Rules & Server Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! The new Steam rules and server update is officially out; once again, this new update will do the following:

[list]
[*] Online games will be wiped
[*] Existing offline games won’t load
[*] The update through Steam will be required to play online
[/list]
Here are the patch notes for this new update:

[list]
[*] Fixed tutorial/prompt window sorting
[*] Updated front end background
[*] Additional art tutorial support
[*] Updated UI for Jihadist Prestige Victory condition
[*] Reworked Token help popup
[*] Fixed various Ops Tray layout issues (both Jihadist and US Ops Trays)
[*] Added ambient audio slider to game pause
[*] Reworked resolution of half-height cards
[*] Added non playable event warning on player hand cards
[*] Various art optimizations
[*] Reworked map to improve various gameplay visibility issues
[*] Reworked Hold/Discard Last Card mechanic
[*] Moved game Chat popup to allow player to interact with map while visible
[*] Added icon for First Plot in HUD for Jihadist player
[*] Game Waiting icon in game shifted to match front end position
[*] Added Event Tokens (in play) to map country locations
[*] Fixed end game result display issues
[*] Updated end game results screen.
[*] Updated the Covert Action popup.
[*] Added a special indicator to the Plot Resolution overlay when Backlash is in effect.
[*] Condensed Prestige roll results into Plot Resolution for US Plots.
[*] Added a Funding change field to the Major Jihad results overlay.
[*] Faction symbols no longer appear on game slots with "Random Sides" selected.
[*] Updated the Token Help system.
[*] Added adjacency indicators for Patriot Act & Biometrics.
[*] Changed the First Plot display.
[*] Added coloring change for resources under a green Regime Change marker.
[*] Added new buttons for deploying to the Troop Track.
[*] Changed how the final card in the US's hand is handled.
[*] Victory conditions on the Resources tracking popup now reflect the current game type.
[*] Updated how the log handles clicks on card & country names.
[*] Cards that behave differently during automata games now only display the pertinent text while in game.
[*] Added icons for insufficient funding results while recruiting.
[*] Added indicators on cards for when their event is unplayable.
[*] Updated event box to sort icons based on faction.
[*] When selecting a target for War of Ideas, clicking on an invalid target will display why the target is invalid.
[*] Added country-specific markers to affected countries.
[*] Updated country glows.
[*] New music & sound effects.
[*] Added ambient sound system.
[*] Disabled Jihadist AI (for now).
[*] Added special animation for cells animating between the US and the Philippines.
[*] Fixed a bug where offline games could be seen under the tutorial selection.
[*] Fixed a display bug in the Regime Change overlay when Prestige is rolled.
[*] Fixed a bug when committing actions from "Schengen Visas".
[*] Fixed a display bug when playing "Iran".
[*] Fixed a display bug in the Disrupt overlay.
[*] Fixed a display bug in the Alert overlay.
[*] Fixed a bug when attempting to add a user to your friend list by name.
[*] Fixed a display bug when targeting a country for Regime Change.
[*] Fixed a bug where the map was interactable while dragging a card.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Rematch button wouldn't respond correctly.
[*] Fixed a display bug with the US AI thinking indicator.
[*] Fixed a bug where the map would scroll when using the mouse wheel while the cursor wasn't over the map.
[*] Fixed a bug where the in-game waiting icon wasn't displaying when it should.
[*] Fixed a bug where the tutorial could crash on ending.
[*] Fixed a display bug when resolving Jihadist Videos.
[*] Multiple bug fixes regarding the End Turn popup.
[*] Various text/typo issues fixes.
[/list]


As always, we are grateful for the continuous support of Labyrinth and we hope you enjoy. Thanks!

notes.title: Update 05 - v 0.7.4, patch notes, and Mac support!
notes.content:
Hey there guys! Thank you all so much for the support and engagement with the Labyrinth community, your feedback has been very valuable to us; please continue to offer it as we continue to improve the Labyrinth experience. 

We are very excited to announce that we finally support Mac OS Catalina! Thanks to everyone very much for your patience and dedication, we hope the wait was well worth it. If you encounter any issues with the Mac build, please feel free to bring it up in the Steam Community. 

This update also has a few additional fixes and improvements.  

Here are the patch notes for this build:

•	Added updated tool tips in the front end.
•	Added updated tutorial art
•	Fixed an issue preventing the forfeit and network disconnect windows from appearing
•	Various art updates/fixes/clean up throughout.
•	Fixed cards not appearing in discard/removed tray
•	Fixed an issue with deploying into a country that already has troops
•	Added highlighting to several tutorial steps
•	Added MacOS notarization (support for Catalina)

We are doing additional work on tutorial features and also the AI, and will updated everyone on with roadmap on that development. Until then, keep enjoying Labyrinth; we really appreciate the support. 

Hope you guys enjoy; stay safe and happy gaming!

notes.title: Labyrinth Progress Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We really appreciate the tremendous support that has been shown for Labyrinth. We are truly thankful to be able to work with such a great community of gamers. Your feedback has been very helpful and we encourage you to continue to provide your issues, thoughts and ideas here in the Steam community hub. 

We are making continued progress on fixing and polishing Labyrinth while also working to bring more features online. The latest update is out and with it comes a significant rework to the structure of the Jihadist tutorial. From here each section will be modified further with additional art cues and improved flow but this gets it headed down that path. The U.S. tutorial will also get the same treatment. This update also has quite a few interface clean up improvements as well numerous rules and bug fixes. 

The patch note details can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/931950/discussions/0/2149847423917974753/]here:[/url]

For the Mac build, we are making progress with Unity and the Mac certification issue. There have been a few more hurdles than we anticipated but estimate that the full Mac release will be ready by the end of next week.

As for the near term roadmap, we are working with the Labyrinth design team on advanced tutorials that go into further depth on key game aspects as well as general game strategies. We will bring these online in steps and get community feedback at each stage. These will be next in the major update queue with A.I. coming after that.

Again please continue to share your thoughts and ideas on the game and we look forward to making this the best possible digital board game experience!

tags.feature: - The U.S. tutorial will also get the same treatment.

tags.bug: - numerous rules and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 02 Is Live!
notes.content:
Hey everybody, we are really glad you are all enjoying Labyrinth. We just wanted to let everyone know that version 0.7.2 is now live; these are the patch notes for the update:

 [list]
[*]    Revamped Jihadist Operations Tutorial (Work In Progress) 
[*]     Opium is no longer removed from the game after the event is resolved 
[*]     Fixed cases where multiple instances of the same event marker were incorrectly put into play 
[*]     Fixed Israel being affected by Posture Test from an Unblocked Plot 
[*]     Fixed Leak to only block the event from the selected event marker 
[*]     Fixed Saleh event to always set Yemen to Ally 
[*]     Fixed Hariri Killed event to not affect Governance in Syria if already at Islamist Rule

[*]     Fixed Operations Overlay to properly appear when loading into a game with partially completed operation 
[*]     Fixed display of NATO and SADR tokens when reloading a game or undoing an action

[*]     Fixed First Plot to be consumed by Plot Operation with any event card (not just US associated event) 
[*]     Fixed server synchronization issue when playing WMD event (HEU, Loose Nuke, Kazakh Strain) 
[*]     Fixed rare crash when US player initiates Reassessment 
[*]     Jihadist Bot will treat Regional Al-Qaeda event as unplayable if there are no cells on the Funding Track 
[*]     Jihadist Bot will no longer enter Radicalization when resolving Jihadist Videos, Clean Operatives, or Schengen Visas 
[*]     Fixed NATO/NEST token 
[*]     Added Next Game button 
[*]     Fixed Log and Magnify Card sorting order 
[*]     Added new images to Rulebook sections 
[*]     Updated Rulebook accent text 
[*]     Standardized dice pips 
[*]     Updated Game Cell for better current player visibility 
[*]     Added Player Ratings result popup after Victory popup for online play 
[*]     Reworked forfeit state of Opponent for better visibility 
[*]     Added online timer and warning state for low time remaining in online play 
[*]     Moved Log button and reworked Log popup 
[*]     Reworked Chat button and new chat indicator various card fixes 
[*]     Added the "Next Game" button 
[*]     Added a new sidebar for displaying the resolution of unblocked Plots 
[*]     Fixed an issue where the troop banner was displaying incorrectly on the disrupt overlay 
[*]     Changed Disrupt Prestige bonus/Cadre banner to not appear until event is complete 
[*]     Fixed display issues in the Friend list when viewing a friend who has not played Labyrinth 
[*]     Fixed an issue with the initial state of the Display Bot Output button on the game log 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 01 is Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thank you for the tremendous amount of interest and support shown for Labyrinth. We appreciate your engagement and the feedback you are providing and will continue to deliver improvements, bug fixes, features and more. Build v0.7.1 is now live for all players and has quite a few bug fixes and adjustments.

•	Made Random Sides not being selectable against AI more clear

•	Fixed the tutorial step index display 
•	Updated the Rulebook

•	Fixed being able to select un-selectable Bot difficulties by swapping sides 
•	Fixed an issue where WMD Operations could cause a synchronization issue in online games:
o	HEU, Kazakh Strain, Loose Nuke
